items.question: How tall is Dorka Juhasz?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Dorka Juhasz at 6 feet 5 inches and 190 pounds.

items.question: What are Dorka Juhasz's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Dorka Juhasz averaged 3.6 points, 3.1 rebounds, and 1.4 assists in 21 games for the Minnesota Lynx.

items.question: Did Dorka Juhasz play at Ohio State and UConn?
items.answer: Yes. Dorka Juhasz was twice named First Team All-Big Ten at Ohio State, then transferred to UConn for her final two college seasons, helping the Huskies reach the 2022 NCAA championship game and the 2023 Sweet 16.

items.question: What WNBA team does Dorka Juhasz play for?
items.answer: Dorka Juhasz plays forward for the Minnesota Lynx, who drafted her in the second round, 16th overall, in 2023. She made the 2023 All-Rookie Team and set the Lynx rookie record with 246 rebounds. She did not play in the WNBA in 2025 and returned to Minnesota in 2026.

items.question: Was Dorka Juhasz EuroLeague MVP?
items.answer: Yes. Dorka Juhasz was named 2025-26 EuroLeague Women MVP with Galatasaray. At 26 she was the youngest winner of the award, averaging 12.8 points and 8.0 rebounds on 52% shooting.

items.question: Where is Dorka Juhasz from?
items.answer: Dorka Juhasz is from Pécs, Hungary. Her WNBA draft bio says she is the daughter of Zsolt and Hajnalka Juhász and has a brother, Gergely.

items.question: Does Dorka Juhasz play for Hungary?
items.answer: Yes. Dorka Juhasz made the All-Star Five at the 2026 World Cup Qualifying Tournament in Istanbul, averaging 18.0 points and 9.0 rebounds as Hungary qualified for its first World Cup since 1998.
